The words परिचाय्यः , पचाय्य and समूह्याः are irregularly formed when they are names of fire.

Terms: Irregular

The affix क्विप्‌ comes after the verb चि 'to collect' with the sense of past time, when the word अग्नि , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.

Terms: क्विप्‌

The affix ढक् comes in the sense of 'this its deity' after the name अग्नि।

Terms: ढक्

In an order given to अग्नीध्र priest, the first syllable as well as the succeeding syllable is प्लुत.

Terms: प्लुत

ष् is substituted for the स् of 1. स्तुत 2. स्तोम and 3. सोम when preceded by अग्नि in a compound.

Terms: ष change
